title: hierarchicalMenu sorting problem
body: How can I define a sortBy option for each level in hierarchicalMenu widget?

comments.body:
This is not currently doable.

Can you provide me more information on your usecase/data? Thanks.

Thanks for your reply @vvo,
I want to use it to sort product categories, for example
Clothing
  Clothing > Dresses
    Clothing > Mini Dresses
    Clothing > Midi Dresses
  Clothing > Tops
  Clothing > Bottoms
  Clothing > Outwears
Accessories
  Accessories > Jewelery
  Accessories > Bags
...

I need to sort items by levels name:desc - count:desc -  or custom sort function for each level.
So you want first level to be count based and second level to be name based?
Awesome! Very nice. I knew the custom sort with a function could help someone at some point ;)
Thanks a lot for giving us feedback
